title: 初一听对话判断：自行车留言
instruction: 听完整对话，判断四个陈述正误，选T（正确）或F（错误）。本机音轨内对话一遍，可自行重播；来源未规定统一重播次数，不当成考试只能听一次。
audio_introduction: Listen to the conversation. Nell, Ted and Luke are talking outside a bicycle repair shop. Read the four statements. Choose true or false.

clips.context: Nell, Ted and Luke are talking outside a bicycle repair shop.

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: Not yet, Luke. The man is putting on a new wheel. He says I can collect it at half past four.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: But the shop closes at five. Can you get here in time?

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: I have music practice until twenty past four, so I cannot walk here quickly enough.

turns.speaker: L
turns.text: I can collect it for you. My lesson finishes at four.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Good idea. Ted, write down the number on your paper ticket for Luke.

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: Thanks, both of you. I will leave the ticket with Luke now.

questions.stem: Ted is having a new wheel put on his bicycle.
questions.rationale: Ted明说putting on a new wheel；F与修理内容冲突。

questions.stem: The shop closes at half past four.
questions.rationale: half past four是可取车时间，Nell明说五点关门；T把两个时间混为一谈。

questions.stem: Luke offers to collect the bicycle for Ted.
questions.rationale: Luke说I can collect it for you；F与主动帮助冲突。

questions.stem: Ted decides to keep the ticket with him.
questions.rationale: Ted结尾决定leave the ticket with Luke now；T与明确决定相反。
